title: PolicyComparisonSuite
description: Versioned, promotion-gated comparison corpus (P3-E4-S03 / ADR-0018). Each case pins a stable caseId to an immutable ReplayBundle content hash — adding a case never mutates an existing caseId's ReplayBundle. The adversarial revision that edits an existing caseId's fixture in place is forbidden: represent it as a new caseId so historical promotion-gate results stay reproducible. promotionGates is a schema-level pass/fail table keyed by delta kind (consumed by assent compare / E6, never by prose alone). acceptedDeltas is an explicit allowlist keyed by caseId + delta identity (rule/subject[/obligation]) + kind — never by kind alone, closing the "accept all deltas of this kind" footgun. explanation-only deltas are structurally excluded from every failOnKinds list.

version.description: Suite revision label. Bumping version does not authorize mutating an existing caseId's digest — mint a new caseId instead (immutable corpus).

baselineProfile.description: Default baseline PolicyProfile ref for suite runs (overridable per compare invocation).

candidateProfile.description: Default candidate PolicyProfile ref for suite runs.

cases.description: Immutable corpus entries. caseId is stable forever; replayBundleDigest must not change under that caseId.

promotionGates.description: Exactly the five machine-enforceable promotion gates (zero missed destructive; zero missed authorization/ownership; no unexpected obligation removal; bounded auto-merge widening; explicitly accepted deltas). Each gate is a deterministic pass/fail function of delta kind + the suite's acceptedDeltas allowlist.

acceptedDeltas.description: Explicit per-delta allowlist. Keys are caseId + kind + identity (rule/subject[/obligation]) — never kind alone. A destructive-or-authorization-intervention-missed delta always fails its gate unless individually listed here.

caseId.description: Stable corpus identity. Never reuse a caseId for a different ReplayBundle.

replayBundleDigest.description: Content hash of the pinned ReplayBundle (P3-E1). Immutable corpus invariant: under a fixed caseId this digest MUST NOT change across suite revisions — revise by adding a new caseId.

replayBundleRef.description: Optional path or URI of the pinned ReplayBundle fixture whose content hashes to replayBundleDigest.

description.description: Human-facing case summary; not used by promotion-gate evaluation.

promotionGate.description: One row of the schema-level promotion pass/fail table. explanation-only is never listed in failOnKinds.

gateId.description: Closed gate identity. The first two both key off destructive-or-authorization-intervention-missed (taxonomy combines destructive + authorization/ownership misses); gateId distinguishes the reporting axis.

failOnKinds.description: Delta kinds that fail this gate unless individually present in acceptedDeltas (when acceptance is per-delta-identity).

defaultVerdict.description: Verdict when a matching delta is present and not allowlisted. Semantic gates use fail.

acceptance.description: none: matching deltas always fail (no allowlist escape). per-delta-identity: an acceptedDeltas entry keyed by caseId + identity (+ kind) may pass that specific delta — never a kind-wide accept.

acceptedDelta.description: One explicitly accepted delta. rule + subject (optional obligation) are the mandatory delta identity so authors cannot accept "all deltas of kind X".

caseId.description: Must name an existing suite caseId.

obligation.description: Delta identity: obligation name when applicable.

rationale.description: Why this specific delta is accepted for promotion.
